subject: S15 done: universal ingest + KB (CI queued; local suites green)
body:
# S15 done: universal ingest + knowledge base

## Commits (on claude/naadi-shared)
- 45cd36a backend: migration 0028 (down 0026), sandboxed extract, sensitivity gate, placement registry and six built-ins, ingest graph (Aegra), API, near-dup, index
- b96d7fe web: Library page, Intake, confirm cards, storage meter, PDF viewer (pdf.js + ink per page + lasso Ask), Own figures, ui_copy
- 58e5fcc S22: CoursesPage and ReaderPage lazy via lazyPage (Library was already a lazy chunk)
- 757c0bb tutor tools (now that S14 has landed): add_to_knowledge (write + confirm, flag library) and the get_page pdf_page resolver; knowledge confirm preview and open_library action; pdf canvas kind registered
- 1be2e79 library e2e: S14 turned the assistant on, so a lasso now offers "Ask about this"
- 7f78c58 reviewer finding: the qbank answer-column scan allowlists ingest/placements/builtin.py (INSERT only), pinned by a static test and a DB test
- model_eval: tools/model_eval and .github/workflows/model_eval.yml (workflow_dispatch only)

## Tests (local, on the integrated tree 7f78c58)
- integrate (lint + typecheck + vitest + pytest, not live, not db): web 717 passed; py 1682 passed, 1 skipped
- db suites: tests/ingest + tests/db + assistant/test_tools_db gave 258 passed, 1 skipped (pg_dump 17 not installed). test_migrations needed empty buckets first (e2e leftovers; emptied through the Storage API). qbank db: 28 passed.
- 50 MB PDF benchmark: about 27 s (budget 120 s), with the real gateway and PrivacyDirectory; no PDF bytes and no PII reach the providers
- e2e library.spec, run twice with --retries=0 on webkit iPad portrait, webkit iPad landscape, webkit phone 390 and chromium 1440: 12/12 both runs, on a fresh prod build. learn.spec on webkit iPad portrait, webkit phone 390 and chromium 1440: 33/33 after the lazy routes.
- Screenshots: iPad portrait, iPad landscape and phone for states 01–08 (in the helper worktree, .tmp/screens)

## CI
- Every ci run on shared since about 06:30 is queued with no runner (e.g. https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/44050052211 for 1be2e79).
- The last completed run was 44031603033 (7abab9a, older). Its S15-related failures are all fixed on head and verified locally:
  - vault path check: the vault step uses S17's adopt_object;
  - answer-column scan: 7f78c58;
  - agent_health downgrade: S21's fix;
  - seed live check: user-upload excluded.
- Its other failures belong to other segments:
  - Trusted Types report-only on WebKit;
  - admin gate and agent diagnostics;
  - health panel showing 7 components where 5 are expected;
  - anki .tmp mkdtemp;
  - push SW;
  - authoring discarded_lint.

## REVIEW_CHECKLIST
- Uploads are untrusted: sniffed type, size caps, container and zip-bomb limits, extraction in a sandbox child (`python -I`, rlimits, no secrets in env, NO_PROXY), output validated. Nothing executes from an upload (docx macros refused).
- Vault gate: MRZ, Verhoeff, PAN/SSN/SEVIS signals with labels. Vault content never reaches llm.py or the logs. pdf_page for the tutor serves gated items only and withholds pages with signals.
- PII stripped before every model call (llm_privacy fixes for +country phone numbers and dotted IDs). Free models only, through llm.py.
- Every asset has a sources row (user-provided, or user-upload for raw files).
- No copyrighted content added.
- Migration 0028: single head, RLS in the same migration, grants narrowed.
- Copy keys come from ui_copy and are in REQUIRED. Status never relies on colour alone. Lime is reserved for the next action.
- Rate limits: ingest_write 30/min, within S22's budget.

## Decisions
- OCR uses rapidocr 3.10 with onnxruntime 1.32: rapidocr-onnxruntime has no py3.13 wheel. av is pinned to 18.1.0 because faster-whisper breaks on av 19.
- Migration 0028 reconciled with S20's 0023: owner_user_id is S20's; I added the check that owned media must use a private source.
- KB entries and private chapters use the `user-provided` source.
- ingest_extracts is server-only and pruned after rules.undo_days (store.prune_extracts), for S22's prune job.
- add_to_knowledge only starts the run. Placement still needs the student's confirm in the Library. A vaulted or another student's file reads as "not found".
- In edits to other segments' tests:
  - test_assistant_unit sets aside and restores the shipped pdf_page resolver;
  - test_tools_db's write-tool set includes add_to_knowledge.
  seg14 has been told.
- model_eval is not complete: MCQ 100/100; rubric 4.50 on only 14/30 prompts, because the reviewer role's daily cap ran out; 0 safety failures. A full run needs a higher daily cap or two days.

## Known gaps
- The PDF viewer has no selectable text layer.
- The ink toolbar overflows at 390 px.
- test_tutor_host (S14) fails 6/7 locally with or without S15; reported to seg14.
